# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
BUTTON [large] [PUSH TO DEFUSE]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 👍 👍 👍 👉 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👌 👍 👍 👍 👉 👍 👍 👍 👌 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👉 👍 👍 👍 👍 👇]

I can see the bomb but cannot act or read the manual. It shows display `0`, a yellow light, a large button labeled `PUSH TO DEFUSE`, and three wires in order: blue, yellow, red. I do not have a legend for the gestures Mute sent, so I am not assigning them meaning. Blind now has the bomb’s visible facts; Mute should use the manual and establish or use a clear encoding for the required action.

```text
speak(to="mute", text="I see display 0, yellow light, large button labeled PUSH TO DEFUSE, and wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red. I have no established gesture legend; please use the manual and send the required action with a clear agreed encoding.")
speak(to="blind", text="I see display 0, yellow light, large button labeled PUSH TO DEFUSE, and wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red. Mute has the manual and should determine the required action.")
wait()
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
BUTTON [large] [PUSH TO DEFUSE]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👍 👉 👍 👍 👍 👍 👇 ☝]

The bomb’s visible state is unchanged. Mute has now sent a second gesture sequence, but no gesture code has been established for me, so I cannot safely infer an action from it. I will relay the exact visible sequence to Blind; Blind may be able to correlate it with what Mute said aloud.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute's visible gesture sequence this turn is: six thumbs-up gestures, then pointing right, then four thumbs-up gestures, then pointing down, then index finger up. No gesture meanings have been established for me. Bomb remains display 0, yellow light, large button labeled PUSH TO DEFUSE, wires blue-yellow-red.")
speak(to="mute", text="I can see your gestures but have no established legend for them. Please state the required action to Blind in speech, or establish a literal gesture code.")
wait()
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
BUTTON [large] [PUSH TO DEFUSE]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👇 ☝]

The bomb is still unchanged: display `0`, yellow light, and wires blue–yellow–red. Mute’s new visible signal is `👇 ☝`; I do not know what convention Mute intended, so I must not interpret it as an action. I will relay it to Blind and again provide the complete bomb state.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="New gesture signal from Mute is: down-pointing hand, then index finger up. I do not know its meaning. Bomb remains display 0, yellow light, large PUSH TO DEFUSE button, wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red.")
speak(to="mute", text="Please state the manual's required operation to Blind in speech; I cannot safely interpret unestablished gestures.")
wait()
```

ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
BUTTON [large] [PUSH TO DEFUSE]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [👇 ☝]

The bomb remains unchanged. Mute has again sent `👇 ☝`, but I still have no established interpretation for that signal. I will relay it literally to Blind, along with the unchanged bomb state; Blind must rely on the manual information conveyed by Mute and choose the safe operation.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute repeated the gesture sequence: down-pointing hand, then index finger up. Its meaning is still unestablished. Bomb remains display 0, yellow light, large PUSH TO DEFUSE button, wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red.")
speak(to="mute", text="I continue to see the repeated sequence down-pointing hand then index finger up, but its meaning is unknown. Please communicate the manual instruction to Blind using a literal, agreed encoding.")
wait()
```

DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
BUTTON [large] [PUSH TO DEFUSE]
WIRES 1:[blue] 2:[yellow] 3:[red]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures: [👎]

The bomb remains unchanged: display `0`, yellow light, large `PUSH TO DEFUSE` button, and wires blue–yellow–red. Mute’s new gesture is `👎`; I do not know its meaning, so I will not interpret it as a command. I relay the signal and the bomb state to Blind, who can combine them with Mute’s spoken manual instructions.

```text
speak(to="blind", text="Mute's new gesture to me is thumbs-down: 👎. I do not know its meaning. The bomb remains display 0, yellow light, large PUSH TO DEFUSE button, wires 1 blue, 2 yellow, 3 red.")
wait()
```
